# What this exercises

The config-hash idiom converted as a record: a named `my %job` with written
out keys and mixed value kinds becomes a struct, with direct field reads and
writes, a field added after the initialiser, the field list written out for
`sort keys`, a run-time field pick through the generated by-name switch, and
an arrayref field dereferenced into a join.

# What makes it hard

The record decision needs the whole file: any use that treats the keys as
data (delete, exists, a computed write, a slice, the hash used whole) has to
push the same hash back to a map. This entry stays on the record side of
every one of those lines, so it pins the positive case.
